queue.title: Payment operations
queue.description: Executions of your bank that need attention. Nothing here edits a ledger, a balance or a status: you can inquire and propose a safe repair.

detail.title: Execution
detail.phase: Phase when the answer was lost
detail.inquireHelp: Asks the simulated core about the ORIGINAL reference. If the posting exists it is acknowledged — never sent again.

inquiryOutcome.BOOKED: The core has the posting. It was acknowledged; no second debit.
inquiryOutcome.NOT_FOUND: The core has no posting under this reference. The execution stays unknown until a repair is approved.
inquiryOutcome.UNAVAILABLE: The core did not answer. Nothing was changed. Try again later.

detail.repairHelp: A different person with the repair approval permission must approve. The repair inquires once more before it acts.

actionHelp.RESUBMIT_SAME_REFERENCE: Sends the original instruction again under its original reference. If the first attempt arrives late, the core treats both as one posting.
actionHelp.MARK_FAILED_UNPOSTED: Ends the execution as failed before posting, releases the reserved funds and the reserved limit. The corporate can then submit a new payment.

blocked.NOT_UNKNOWN: A repair is only possible for an unknown outcome.
blocked.INQUIRE_FIRST: Inquire first. A repair can be proposed only after the core answered that it has no posting.
blocked.CORE_HAS_POSTING: The core has the posting, so no repair is needed.
blocked.OPEN_PROPOSAL: A repair proposal is already awaiting a decision.

results.RESUBMITTED: Sent again under the same reference

detail.noAccess: Your role can view executions but not act on them.

recon.title: Reconciliation
recon.description: Compares what the platform expects with the simulated core's extract for one business date. A break is recorded, never corrected here.
recon.noBreaks: No breaks: every expected posting matches the core extract.

dispositions.CORRECTED_AT_SOURCE: Corrected at source by the bank

recon.resolutionNote: A disposition is added to the history. It never changes a ledger and cannot be edited or removed.
recon.refresh: The run is still being prepared. Refresh in a moment.

sim.title: Sandbox simulator
sim.description: Fixture controls for the SIMULATED core and rails. They exist only in the sandbox and never change a ledger or a balance.
sim.clockOffset: Ahead of real time by {minutes, plural, =0 {0 minutes} one {# minute} other {# minutes}}
sim.clockNote: Sandbox-wide. Time only moves forward, so no closed business window reopens.
sim.availabilityNote: Sandbox-wide switches for the simulated systems.
sim.faultsNote: A one-off fault for an execution of your bank, used the next time that reference reaches the simulated core.

faultKind.TIMEOUT_AFTER_BOOKING: Posted, then the answer is lost

sim.overlaysNote: Make the core's extract differ from its ledger for one reference to demonstrate break detection. The ledger is not changed.
